name: Salvacañete (Spain)
description: Green field with a white central stripe bearing seven brown pales, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Salvacañete (a castle, a bird and a book).
history: Municipal flag of Salvacañete; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: seven pales on the white stripe
